lines.zh: 我贴着冰底滑，鳍硬得像小刀
lines.en: I slide over the ice floor, fins stiff as knives.

lines.zh: 我的身体有一半是冰，走得慢
lines.en: Half of me is ice; I move slowly.

lines.zh: 冰面下没有别人，只有我的痕
lines.en: No one under the ice but my own trail.

lines.zh: 我挪一下，冰层裂出一条细纹
lines.en: I shift, and a thin crack runs through the ice.

lines.zh: 冷水托着我，像托一块石头
lines.en: Cold water holds me like it holds a stone.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水更冷了一点
lines.en: The water is a little colder where I pass.

lines.zh: 我不用力，冰会替我省力
lines.en: I do not strain; the ice spares me the effort.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上结着霜，走路带响
lines.en: Frost coats my scales; my walking clicks.

lines.zh: 这片海底白得看不见边界
lines.en: This seabed is white past any edge I see.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个弯，冰屑跟着落
lines.en: I turn slowly; chips of ice fall after me.

lines.zh: 我不成群，一条就是一群
lines.en: I form no school; one of me is a school.

lines.zh: 冰缝里有暗水，我从那里过去
lines.en: Dark water in the cracks; I pass through there.

lines.zh: 我压过雪一样的东西，它不化
lines.en: I press something snow-like; it does not melt.

lines.zh: 越往深处越冷，我反而更稳
lines.en: Deeper is colder, and I am steadier there.

lines.zh: 我半身冻在冰里，挪一下要很久。
lines.en: Half frozen into the ice, I take a long time to shift.

lines.zh: 冰下的水不动，我也不动。
lines.en: The water under the ice is still, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰面滑，像被推的石头。
lines.en: I slide along the ice like a stone being pushed.

lines.zh: 冷到极处，连水都没有声音。
lines.en: At this cold, even the water makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我停在冰面上，像被冻在那儿
lines.en: I rest on the ice as if frozen in place.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气在嘴里结了一层
lines.en: My breath freezes a layer inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 冰把我半个身子收进去了
lines.en: The ice has taken half my body in.

lines.zh: 我不冷，我只是很慢
lines.en: I am not cold; I am only slow.

lines.zh: 霜在背上长，长成一小片白
lines.en: Frost grows on my back into a white patch.

lines.zh: 静下来，能听见冰在深处响
lines.en: Quiet, I hear the ice crack deep below.

lines.zh: 我睁着一只眼，另一只冻住了
lines.en: One eye is open; the other froze shut.

lines.zh: 冷水让我清醒，也让我懒得动
lines.en: Cold water keeps me awake and idle.

lines.zh: 冰层上面的脚步，我听得见
lines.en: I hear footsteps up on the ice sheet.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收进身下，省点热
lines.en: I tuck my fins beneath me to save heat.

lines.zh: 独自待着最省事，也最安全
lines.en: Being alone is easiest, and safest.

lines.zh: 冰在化，可化得很慢很慢
lines.en: The ice is melting, very very slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的霜又厚了一层
lines.en: Another layer of frost settles on me.

lines.zh: 这片冷，我已经住惯了
lines.en: I have grown used to this cold.

lines.zh: 你踩上冰面，我先听见了
lines.en: You stepped onto the ice; I heard first.

lines.zh: 你裹得那么厚，我这里可没这么暖
lines.en: You are wrapped so thick; it is not warm here.

lines.zh: 我的眼从冰下抬起来看你
lines.en: My eye rises from under the ice to you.

lines.zh: 你哈出的白气，和我说的一样
lines.en: Your white breath looks just like mine.

lines.zh: 你的靴子边结了冰，走不快
lines.en: Ice crusts your boots; you cannot walk fast.

lines.zh: 我从冰里看你，像隔着一层玻璃
lines.en: I see you through ice, like through glass.

lines.zh: 你伸手试水温，我就在下面
lines.en: You test the water's cold; I am beneath it.

lines.zh: 你抖了一下，我却觉得很舒服
lines.en: You shiver; I find it comfortable.

lines.zh: 我们离得很近，你的热气我受不住
lines.en: So close; your warmth is more than I can bear.

lines.zh: 别敲冰，那声音会传到我骨头里
lines.en: Do not tap the ice; it rings into my bones.

lines.zh: 冰壳碎了，我疼得缩成一团
lines.en: My ice shell breaks; I curl up in pain.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打暖了一点，很难受
lines.en: That blow warmed me slightly; it feels wrong.

lines.zh: 血冻在伤口上，流不出来
lines.en: Blood freezes at the wound and will not flow.

lines.zh: 我退进冰缝，那里你最不好找
lines.en: I back into a crack, the hardest place to find.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一块冰，像掉了块肉
lines.en: A chunk of ice falls off me like flesh.

lines.zh: 疼我忍得住，冷我忍不住
lines.en: I can bear pain; I cannot bear warmth.

lines.zh: 你那一击，让冰层裂到了我脚下
lines.en: Your blow cracked the ice under my fins.

lines.zh: 我游不快，只能硬受着
lines.en: I cannot swim fast; I must simply endure.

lines.zh: 四点五生命，掉一点就很清楚
lines.en: Four and a half hearts; losing one is felt.

lines.zh: 我受伤后会沉底，冻住伤口
lines.en: Hurt, I sink and let the cold seal it.

lines.zh: 饵沉下来，冷得几乎不动
lines.en: The bait sinks, almost too cold to move.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西了，冰下没有活物
lines.en: I have not eaten long; nothing lives under ice.

lines.zh: 那点味道在冷水里散得很慢
lines.en: That smell spreads slowly in cold water.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，冰碴跟着掉出来
lines.en: I open my mouth; chips of ice fall out.

lines.zh: 我在钩边犹豫，冷让我懒得急
lines.en: I hesitate by the hook; cold makes me slow to rush.

lines.zh: 一口热的食物，我想都不敢想
lines.en: A warm meal is beyond my imagining.

lines.zh: 我挪过去，冰在身子下面响
lines.en: I creep over; the ice creaks beneath me.

lines.zh: 饿到发僵，我还是要吃
lines.en: Stiff with hunger, I still want to eat.

lines.zh: 你的饵是暖的，这很反常
lines.en: Your bait is warm; that is unnatural.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，牙齿碰到金属
lines.en: I bite once; my teeth meet metal.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我身上的霜掉了一层
lines.en: You bump me and a layer of frost falls off.

lines.zh: 我硬得像块冰，撞久了你会疼
lines.en: I am hard as ice; that will hurt you later.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，把你的手冻得发白
lines.en: I press to you and bleach your hand white.

lines.zh: 那一下没推动我，只是滑开
lines.en: That shove did not move me, only slid me.

lines.zh: 我身上凉，隔着水你也感觉得到
lines.en: I am cold; you feel it even through water.

lines.zh: 冰壳裂了，我在里面动了一下
lines.en: The ice shell cracks; I stir inside it.

lines.zh: 你退开，手上留了一片白印
lines.en: You pull back with a white mark on your hand.

lines.zh: 我不躲，躲起来太费力气
lines.en: I do not dodge; dodging costs too much.

lines.zh: 我又沉下去一点，冰把我接住
lines.en: I sink a little; the ice catches me.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，比冰层挤压轻多了
lines.en: That bump is lighter than the ice's own pressure.

lines.zh: 我们本来就少见，遇到更难
lines.en: We are rare; meeting is rarer still.

lines.zh: 两条冻鱼并排，冰把我们一起收下
lines.en: Two frozen fish side by side; the ice takes us both.

lines.zh: 它身上的霜比我的薄一点
lines.en: Its frost is a little thinner than mine.

lines.zh: 我们没有追闹，只是靠在一起
lines.en: No chasing, no play; we simply lean together.

lines.zh: 冷得说不出话，我们用鳍相碰
lines.en: Too cold for words; we touch fins.

lines.zh: 在一起会暖一点，就一点
lines.en: Together we are warmer, but only slightly.

lines.zh: 冰下没有季节，我们照旧成对
lines.en: No seasons under ice; we pair all the same.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会比我更耐寒
lines.en: Our young will endure cold better than I.

lines.zh: 它先贴过来，冰在我们之间化开
lines.en: It comes close; ice melts between us.

lines.zh: 分开之后，我们各自冻回原样
lines.en: Parted, we each freeze back into shape.

lines.zh: 东西掉在冰上，滑得抓不住
lines.en: Things fall on ice and slide out of reach.

lines.zh: 我推不动，我的鳍已经冻僵
lines.en: I cannot push; my fins have frozen stiff.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，它比我还冷
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth; it is colder than I.

lines.zh: 掉下来的鱼竿，在冰上弹了一下
lines.en: The dropped rod bounces once on the ice.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，算是收好了
lines.en: I press it under my body; that counts as keeping.

lines.zh: 冰会自己把东西埋起来
lines.en: The ice buries things by itself.

lines.zh: 我背上有霜，驮不住什么
lines.en: Frost on my back; nothing rides there.

lines.zh: 有块冰落进水里，我绕开它
lines.en: A block of ice falls in; I swim around it.

lines.zh: 桶口结了一层白，我看见了
lines.en: Frost rings the bucket's mouth; I see it.

lines.zh: 我拿不走，只好看着它沉
lines.en: I cannot carry it; I watch it sink.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道有东西在
lines.en: The water stirs; something is here.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个影子，慢慢转过去
lines.en: I fix on the shadow and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 冰下的声音很少，所以很清楚
lines.en: Little sound under ice, so it is clear.

lines.zh: 我认准了钩子落下的那一点
lines.en: I mark the exact point where the hook fell.

lines.zh: 有热的东西靠近了，我很不习惯
lines.en: Something warm is near; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼游得慢，我比它更慢
lines.en: That small fish is slow; I am slower.

lines.zh: 我先看它，再决定要不要动
lines.en: I look first, then decide whether to move.

lines.zh: 我锁定的东西一般跑不掉
lines.en: What I fix on rarely gets away.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在冰上，我抬头
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the ice; I look up.

lines.zh: 目标离我三格，我大概要走很久
lines.en: The target is three blocks off; that is a long walk.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，从冰下慢慢挪
lines.en: I follow beneath the ice, shifting slowly.

lines.zh: 你走一步，冰响一声
lines.en: Each step of yours cracks the ice.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，我只是不掉队
lines.en: I do not close in; I only keep up.

lines.zh: 白底上，我的影子很淡
lines.en: On white ground my shadow is faint.

lines.zh: 那条线在水里，我盯着它
lines.en: The line is in the water; I watch it.

lines.zh: 我等你自己停下来
lines.en: I wait for you to stop yourself.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气暴露了位置
lines.en: Your breath gives your position away.

lines.zh: 冰缝是我的路，我沿着它走
lines.en: Cracks are my roads; I follow them.

lines.zh: 追久了，我身上结的霜更厚
lines.en: The longer I chase, the thicker my frost.

lines.zh: 你回头看不见我，我在冰下面
lines.en: You look back and miss me; I am under the ice.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，寒气先到
lines.en: I ram; the cold arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像薄冰，划开一道口子
lines.en: My fins cut like thin ice and open a line.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，冷得发麻
lines.en: I bite your finger; it goes numb.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的霜全抖到你身上
lines.en: The impact shakes all my frost onto you.

lines.zh: 我打得很慢，但很冷
lines.en: My strikes are slow, but very cold.

lines.zh: 你退开时，袖口已经硬了
lines.en: When you back off, your cuff has stiffened.

lines.zh: 我用冰壳的边角顶你
lines.en: I butt you with the rim of my ice shell.

lines.zh: 四点五生命，够我打上几回
lines.en: Four and a half hearts; enough for a few rounds.

lines.zh: 冰屑粘在你皮肤上，很难弄掉
lines.en: Ice chips stick to your skin and will not come off.

lines.zh: 我不追击，冷会替我追
lines.en: I do not pursue; the cold pursues for me.

lines.zh: 我在结冰的水里睁开眼，很慢
lines.en: I open my eyes in freezing water, slowly.

lines.zh: 四周没有同伴，只有白
lines.en: No kin around me, only white.

lines.zh: 冰在我身上先长起来，我才动
lines.en: Ice grew on me first; then I moved.

lines.zh: 这片冷海底空着，我落了下来
lines.en: This cold floor was empty; I settled in.

lines.zh: 出生时我全身僵硬，现在也是
lines.en: I was stiff at birth; I still am.

lines.zh: 水冷得能听见自己结冰
lines.en: The water is cold enough to hear freezing.

lines.zh: 一条鱼在冰下醒来，没有别人
lines.en: One fish wakes under ice, and no other.

lines.zh: 我从裂缝里被水推出来
lines.en: The water pushed me out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我落在冰面上，滑了一小段
lines.en: I landed on the ice and slid a little.

lines.zh: 我来的地方比这里还冷
lines.en: The place I came from is colder still.

lines.zh: 火先把我烤软，再把我杀死
lines.en: Fire softens me first, then finishes me.

lines.zh: 我从冰面摔下，摔出许多白屑
lines.en: I fall from the ice and break into white chips.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进鳃里，比冰还难受
lines.en: Cold water floods my gills, worse than ice.

lines.zh: 爆炸把冰底炸开，我掉进空洞
lines.en: The blast opens the ice floor and I drop through.

lines.zh: 箭射穿冰壳，扎进我冻硬的肉
lines.en: The arrow pierces my shell into frozen flesh.

lines.zh: 魔法是热的，我最怕热
lines.en: Magic is warm, and warmth is what I fear.

lines.zh: 冰下没什么可吃，我越来越轻
lines.en: Little to eat under ice; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷击碎冰面，白光烫了我一下
lines.en: Lightning shatters the ice; white light burns me.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从冰里拿走，一点不剩
lines.en: The void takes me from the ice, leaving nothing.
